arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent game sprite converting the first pixel reference into the clean outlined Cartoon style of the second reference. Image1 is exact pose/action/silhouette authority; its diagnostic palette is not material truth. Image2 is IDENTITY AND MATERIAL ONLY, never a pose template. Same adult small worker: black cap, green long-sleeve shirt, royal-blue bib overalls, tan face/hands, dark shoes, crisp black ink and simple cel shading. Upright worker turned slightly toward screen-LEFT in three-quarter/profile, gaze left, one main visible eye. ONE charcoal hammer held low on screen-left beside upper thigh and partly hidden by hand/body. Other sleeve close to screen-right side. Feet separated with one leg partly overlapped by the other. Preserve low hammer silhouette and leg occlusion; no additional black object between legs. Preserve source whole-body proportions, exact facing, bent joints, hand overlap and prop positions. Show only limbs actually visible. No third arm/sleeve, floating hand, added equipment, scenery, ground, cast shadow, glow, text or watermark. Genuine transparent RGBA background, ample clear padding around every extremity and attached prop, smooth contours rather than tracing pixel stairs. Image3 supplies the EXACT same tool identity: compact rectangular charcoal metal mallet head with charcoal handle, no claw, no brown wood. Rotate that same tool to the source angle and keep the original grip/occlusion. Image3 pose is irrelevant.
